# Musoftwares - Full AI Agent Catalog & Knowledge Base

> Deep, comprehensive documentation and full indexes for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents.

## Platform Overview
Musoftwares provides premium software products, plugins, and custom development services.
Base URL: http://localhost

## Machine Readable Endpoints & Specifications
- Services API: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/services
- Categories API: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/categories
- Search API: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/search
- OpenAPI Spec: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/openapi.json

## Service Categories
- **Web Dev**: http://localhost/marketplace/categories/web-dev
